PB-2026-54
Details for PB-2026-54
Published in The Lawton Constitution March 26, April 2, 2026 IN THE DISTRICT COURT WITHIN AND FOR COMANCHE COUNTY, STATE OF OKLAHOMA IN THE MATTER OF THE ESTATE OF GEORGE E. MCKAY, Deceased. Case No. PB-2026-54 NOTICE TO CREDITORS TO PRESENT CLAIMS All persons having claims against GEORGE E. MCKAY, deceased, are required to present the same with a description of all security interests and other collateral, if any, held by each creditor with respect to such claim, to MARK A. MCKAY, Personal Representative of said estate, at 802 "C" Avenue, Post Office Box 29, Lawton, Oklahoma 73502, on or before the following presentment date: May 29, 2026, or the same will be forever barred. DATED the 24th day of March, 2026. _/s/ Mark A. McKay Mark A. McKay Austin B. Rabon, OBA #33592 GODLOVE, MAYHALL, DUTCHER, RABON, & WATSON, PC 802 "C" Avenue - P.O. Box 29 Lawton, Oklahoma 73502 Phone (580) 353-6700 Fax (580) 353-2900 Attorney for Personal Representative
